description: The unsigned withdraw(token, amount, to) transaction for the owner: any asset, any amount, no delay. amount "all" takes the whole balance of that token. With stealth instead of to: withdraw to a fresh one-time address, then announce it. Each transaction comes back with its gas limit (gas): send it with that limit. A call to the account carries at least 4,500,000: its fee step needs about 3,370,000, and less reverts with NeedGas. Needs the owner's signed request (auth) for request "withdraw".

account.description: The factor account's 0x address (open_account returns it). Accounts are found by address, never by agentId.

auth.description: The account owner's signed request: sign the text account_request_message returns (EIP-191 personal_sign) with the owner's own key; it must recover to owner(), so a contract-wallet owner cannot use these tools yet. Good for five minutes; issued may be at most 30 seconds ahead.

issued.description: The ISO 8601 UTC time in the signed text.

stealth.description: Instead of an address: a stealth meta-address (st:eth:0x<spending key><viewing key>) or the 0x address that registered one in the ERC-6538 registry. The money goes to a fresh one-time address and an ERC-5564 announcement is added last.

to.description: Where the money goes (or give stealth).

token.description: USDG, ETH, WETH, or a stock token symbol (SPY, QQQ, NVDA, TSLA, AAPL, GOOGL, MSFT, SPCX, PLTR, COIN, MSTR, GME).
